title: Antonioli.eu Products Scraper
description: Collect structured product data from Antonioli.eu using one product, collection, catalog, or search URL, or use a keyword when no URL is supplied. If both URL and keyword are supplied, URL takes priority.

url.title: URL
url.description: A public Antonioli.eu product, collection, catalog, or search URL. Leave empty to use keyword mode.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Product keyword such as Gucci, sneakers, or leather bag. Use this when URL is empty.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of unique products to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum collection or catalog pages to request. Product URLs use one request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy settings for production runs.
